evidence.decision: Launch bounded paired longer training; promising temporal-geometry configuration, not scientific admission.
evidence.rationale: Both seeds reproduce large physical and derivative improvements, including recovery of the fast early kinetic transient. Retain original sigma sampling; added low-sigma coverage has no stable advantage across the targeted physical errors.
limitations: All physical and derivative audits still detect distribution differences; every original strict scorecard remains failed.
Late physical derivatives remain about six to seven times the reference, despite large improvement over baseline.
Late momentum, kinetic spatial variation, spectrum and cross-trajectory tail-summary variance remain too small.
cov_low improves some physical metrics, especially seed1 SW and both physical MMDs; cov_base is selected to isolate geometry, not because it dominates every metric.
Lower validation loss of value_low does not translate to better freely generated answers.
evidence.summary_semantics: RMS is per-trajectory probe RMS then averaged across trajectories; reference is the mean of reference A/B means. No continuum norm or population quantile qualification.
evidence.next_experiment: same train512/validation128; fresh evaluation384; value_base versus cov_base; two new seeds; 1800 seconds per arm; fixed EMA snapshots at 360 and 900 seconds; 128 generated answers per model state

kinetic spatial variation and frequency bands
